label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect at now, from plenitude plus change-cause (inference)
rule: Reductio at the supposed first being: potency now gives possible act, plenitude a past act, the change an external efficient cause, the cause priority, against firstness
meaning: Plenitude plus change-cause. Theta.8's priority of act in definition read as the open bridge that potency in a respect makes act in it possible (7371403f), with the tertia via's plenitude premise and an infinite past: a first being in potency in a respect now was in act in it at some earlier time; whatever was in act in a respect and is later in potency in it has an efficient cause other than itself (966c08c6), which is simply prior to it (ST I q.2 a.3 reading), against firstness. Theta.8's potency-for-the-sake-of-act passage (1050a4-b2) is orientation only. The conclusion is time-indexed: no potency at now. It is not bound to the untimed q.3 a.1 conclusion, whose consumers (69affa96, 358d8c6e via first-being act priority) pass to immutability and eternity. Connection plan: the untimed statement would follow, with potency read as potency at some time, from the five premises at every time (plenitude and an infinite past at every time), or through an open bridge from untimed potency to potency at now; neither is registered, so this route does not reach the root. It uses no composition premise and no cause of composites; it shares only efficient-cause priority with the composition routes. Each of the five premises is needed and the route is not vacuous (Control.PlenitudeOmissions). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
